newsitem.title: USA: Best Products says buyout offer withdrawn.
newsitem.headline: Best Products says buyout offer withdrawn.

text.p: Miami-based Ocean Reef Management Inc has formally withdrawn its offer to buy retailer Best Products Co Inc, Best announced Monday.
Best Products also announced that it is delaying payments and the receipt of certain merchandise shipments from vendors as it explores all options available to it.

Ocean Reef, an investment firm, offered to buy Best Products for $2 a share or roughly $63.2 million on Sept 3. Ocean Reef concluded that Best requires greater resources than it originally expected, according to a statement from Best.
However, Ocean Reef indicated it wanted to continue discussions with Best and said it may develop an alternative proposal.
Industry analysts and vendors have said Best is at a critical juncture and either needs to be sold or seek bankruptcy protection again. Best emerged from Chapter 11 protection in June 1994.
